screening_decisions.reason: RCT comparing LMWH (nadroparin) to placebo for VTE prophylaxis in ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing chemotherapy plus LMWH (dalteparin) to chemotherapy alone in SCLC patients. Meets selection criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing chemotherapy plus warfarin to chemotherapy alone in SCLC patients. Meets selection criteria for oral anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing standard treatment plus enoxaparin to standard treatment alone in SCLC patients. Meets selection criteria.
Phase II randomized study comparing 3 doses of dalteparin without a control/no-treatment group. Does not meet criteria as there is no comparison to no thromboprophylaxis or placebo.

RCT comparing different anticoagulant interventions (LMWH, UFH, antithrombin) for thromboprophylaxis in children with ALL receiving induction chemotherapy. Meets criteria for comparing different anticoagulants.
Two double-blind RCTs comparing LMWH (certoparin) to placebo for VTE prophylaxis in ambulatory patients with metastatic breast or lung cancer. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing dalteparin to placebo in patients with advanced malignancy. Meets selection criteria for anticoagulant vs placebo.
RCT comparing dalteparin to observation (no prophylaxis) in ambulatory cancer patients at high risk for VTE. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind RCT comparing nadroparin to placebo in patients with advanced malignancy. Meets selection criteria.

RCT comparing aspirin to LMWH (enoxaparin) for thromboprophylaxis in patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with lenalidomide. Meets criteria for comparing two different anticoagulants/antiplatelets.
RCT comparing subcutaneous heparin to no heparin in SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing chemoradiotherapy plus bemiparin to chemoradiotherapy alone in limited-stage SCLC. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind RCT comparing very-low-dose warfarin to placebo for thromboembolism prevention in women with metastatic breast cancer receiving chemotherapy. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing apixaban (oral anticoagulant) to placebo for VTE prevention in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing standard treatment plus prophylactic LMWH to standard treatment alone in patients with newly diagnosed lung cancer. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing gemcitabine plus dalteparin to gemcitabine alone in advanced pancreatic cancer patients. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing warfarin to no warfarin in limited-stage SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy and radiation. Meets selection criteria.
Open RCT comparing antithrombin infusions to no antithrombin treatment in children with ALL receiving L-asparaginase. Meets selection criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing aspirin, warfarin, and enoxaparin for thromboprophylaxis in patients with multiple myeloma treated with thalidomide. Meets criteria for comparing different anticoagulants.
RCT comparing chemotherapy plus enoxaparin to chemotherapy alone in ambulatory patients with advanced pancreatic cancer. Meets selection criteria.
Placebo-controlled RCT comparing dalteparin to placebo for VTE prophylaxis in patients with newly diagnosed malignant glioma. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing LMWH to standard care alone in patients with advanced cancer. Meets selection criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
RCT comparing nadroparin to no nadroparin in patients with advanced cancer (NSCLC, prostate, pancreatic). Meets selection criteria.
Controlled RCT comparing warfarin to no warfarin in SCLC patients receiving chemotherapy and radiation. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing enoxaparin to observation in cancer patients with elevated tissue factor-bearing microparticles. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind RCT comparing semuloparin to placebo for VTE prophylaxis in patients receiving chemotherapy for cancer. Meets selection criteria.
Placebo-controlled RCT comparing apixaban to placebo for thromboprophylaxis in ambulatory cancer patients at intermediate-to-high risk initiating chemotherapy. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind RCT comparing rivaroxaban to placebo for thromboprophylaxis in high-risk ambulatory cancer patients. Meets selection criteria.
This appears to be a secondary analysis or further results report of the FRAGMATIC trial (study 16), not a distinct RCT. Should not be included separately.
RCT comparing tinzaparin to no treatment in patients with completely resected NSCLC. Population is post-surgical/adjuvant setting, not ambulatory patients receiving chemotherapy.
Phase 2 trial where aspirin was added mid-study, creating 3 groups retrospectively. Not a proper randomized controlled trial design with concurrent randomization to aspirin vs no aspirin.

Study comparing vena cava filter placement to conservative therapy. Unclear if this is a randomized trial, and vena cava filters are typically used for secondary prevention/treatment rather than primary prophylaxis.
RCT comparing nadroparin to no nadroparin in patients with completely resected NSCLC. Population is post-surgical/adjuvant setting, not ambulatory patients receiving chemotherapy.

Subgroup analysis of CERTIFY trial comparing certoparin to UFH in acutely-ill, non-surgical patients ≥70 years. Population is hospitalized medical patients, not ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.
RCT of intermittent pneumatic compression for postoperative DVT prophylaxis. Population is postoperative patients, not ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.
Observational study comparing patients who received LMWH prophylaxis to those who did not. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Prospective cohort study comparing combined LMWH+antithrombin to antithrombin alone (noncontemporaneous control). Not a randomized controlled trial.
Report describing use of aspirin in three series of MM patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Economic evaluation based on a previous RCT (study 14). Not itself a randomized controlled trial.
Prospective observational cohort study for VTE prediction. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article discussing epidemiology, pathophysiology, and treatment of cancer-associated VTE. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Observational cohort study estimating incidence of VTE in patients with active cancer. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on meta-analysis in clinical trials. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Clinical practice guidelines document. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on GRADE system for rating evidence quality. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on testing for small-study effects in meta-analyses. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on epidemiology of venous thromboembolism. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on measuring inconsistency in meta-analyses. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Retrospective analysis of patients from two RCTs on initial treatment of VTE. Not a primary randomized controlled trial for prophylaxis.
ACCP clinical practice guidelines document. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on bleeding complications during anticoagulant treatment in cancer patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
ASCO clinical practice guideline update. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Development and validation of a predictive model from observational cohorts. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on assessing VTE risk in cancer patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Consensus statement from major guidelines panels. Not a randomized controlled trial.
International prospective observational cohort study on incidental pulmonary embolism. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on thromboprophylaxis guidelines in cancer. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of Khorana score performance. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Retrospective study evaluating VTE incidence in cancer patients treated with chemotherapy. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Prospective follow-up study of patients with existing VTE on anticoagulant treatment. Not a primary prophylaxis RCT.
Methodological paper on heterogeneity assessment in meta-analysis. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Systematic review and meta-analysis on viscosupplementation for knee osteoarthritis. Wrong topic entirely.
Scientific committee communication defining major bleeding. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on funnel plots in meta-analysis. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on explaining heterogeneity in meta-analysis. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on epidemiology of cancer-associated venous thrombosis. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on cancer-associated unsuspected pulmonary embolism. Not a randomized controlled trial.

Phase III RCT comparing thalidomide-based chemotherapy with LMWH prophylaxis (arm B) to vincristine-based chemotherapy without LMWH (arm A) in multiple myeloma. Meets selection criteria for anticoagulant vs no anticoagulant.
Letter to editor commenting on another study. Not a randomized controlled trial.
RCT comparing LMWH to UFH in medical patients, with only a subset having malignant disease. Population is not specifically ambulatory cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.
No abstract available. Cannot determine if this meets selection criteria without full text.
RCT comparing nadroparin to no treatment in cancer patients hospitalized for palliative care. Population is hospitalized palliative care patients, not ambulatory patients receiving chemotherapy.
Phase II trial of isoquercetin (flavonoid) for reducing hypercoagulability. Isoquercetin is not an anticoagulant or mechanical intervention as defined in the selection criteria.
Review article summarizing literature on primary VTE prophylaxis in ambulatory cancer patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on prophylaxis against VTE in ambulatory cancer patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Review article on incidental VTE and anticoagulation. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Systematic review and meta-analysis on VTE risk in cancer patients. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper on assessing quality of controlled trials in systematic reviews. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Cochrane review on anticoagulation for cancer patients with central venous catheters. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Cochrane review on transcutaneous electrostimulation for knee osteoarthritis. Wrong topic entirely.
Observational study linking national registries to assess prognosis of cancer associated with VTE. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Description of a modified Khorana risk score (Protech score). References the PROTECH study but is not itself an RCT report.
